meta.description: Canonical ISO 4217 currency registry. Active ISO currencies, withdrawn ISO currencies, and commonly-used non-ISO currencies maintained as separate arrays. This file is the single source of truth — all wrappers, bindings, and downstream databases derive from this file.

verified_against: Central bank official websites for minor unit verification
source.stablecoin_source: CoinMarketCap top 5 stablecoins by market capitalization, 2026-07-29
source.commodity_source: ISO 4217-compatible codes per SIX Group guidance

withdrawn.note: Revalued at 5000:1 into the Azerbaijani Manat (AZN) on 2007-01-01. AZN remains Azerbaijan's current currency.

withdrawn.name: Spanish Peseta (Account A)
withdrawn.note: Funds code for Spanish Peseta Account A. Withdrawn alongside ESP when Spain adopted the Euro.

withdrawn.name: Spanish Peseta (Account B)
withdrawn.note: Funds code for Spanish Peseta Account B. Withdrawn alongside ESP when Spain adopted the Euro.

withdrawn.name: Israeli Pound
withdrawn.note: Revalued at 10:1 into the Israeli Shekel (ILR) on 1980-02-24.

withdrawn.name: Israeli Shekel (old)
withdrawn.note: Revalued at 1000:1 into the Israeli New Shekel (ILS) on 1986-01-01. ILS remains Israel's current currency.

withdrawn.name: Icelandic Króna (old)
withdrawn.note: Replaced at 1:1 by the Icelandic Króna (ISK) on 1981-01-01. ISK remains Iceland's current currency.

withdrawn.name: Lesotho Loti (old)
withdrawn.note: Replaced at 1:1 by the Lesotho Loti (LSL) on 1985-01-02. LSL remains Lesotho's current currency, pegged 1:1 to ZAR.

withdrawn.name: Monégasque Franc
withdrawn.note: Irrevocably fixed conversion rate to EUR per ECB Council Regulation (EC) No 2866/98. Pegged 1:1 to FRF.

withdrawn.name: Romanian Leu (old)
withdrawn.note: Revalued at 100:1 into the Romanian Leu (ROL) on 1952-01-28. ROL was later revalued into RON in 2005.

withdrawn.name: San Marinese Lira
withdrawn.note: Irrevocably fixed conversion rate to EUR per ECB Council Regulation (EC) No 2866/98. Pegged 1:1 to ITL.

withdrawn.name: Vatican Lira
withdrawn.note: Irrevocably fixed conversion rate to EUR per ECB Council Regulation (EC) No 2866/98. Pegged 1:1 to ITL.

withdrawn.name: Argentine Peso Moneda Nacional
withdrawn.note: Revalued at 100:1 into the Peso Ley (ARL) on 1970-01-01. Predecessor of the Argentine currency chain: ARM → ARL → ARP → ARA → ARS.

withdrawn.name: European Currency Unit
withdrawn.note: Replaced at 1:1 by the Euro (EUR) on 1999-01-01. The ECU was a basket of European currencies used as a unit of account before the Euro's launch.

withdrawn.name: Gold Franc
withdrawn.note: Special settlement currency used by the BIS for international rail transport liabilities. Withdrawn from ISO 4217 in 2003. Withdrawn without a direct currency successor.

withdrawn.name: UIC Franc
withdrawn.note: Special settlement currency used by the International Union of Railways (UIC) for cross-border rail tariffs. Withdrawn from ISO 4217 in 2013.

withdrawn.name: RINET Funds Code
withdrawn.note: Reinsurance and insurance network settlement currency. Withdrawn from ISO 4217.

cryptocurrencies.name: Bitcoin
cryptocurrencies.note: Not an ISO 4217 code. Included due to widespread financial market usage.

cryptocurrencies.name: Ethereum
cryptocurrencies.note: Not an ISO 4217 code. Included due to widespread financial market usage.

commodities.name: Gold (troy ounce)
commodities.note: ISO 4217-compatible code for gold. Not a currency. Minor units of 2 is a practical convention for USD-denominated pricing; no ISO standard exists.

commodities.name: Silver (troy ounce)
commodities.note: ISO 4217-compatible code for silver. Not a currency. Minor units of 2 is a practical convention.

commodities.name: Platinum (troy ounce)
commodities.note: ISO 4217-compatible code for platinum. Not a currency.

commodities.name: Palladium (troy ounce)
commodities.note: ISO 4217-compatible code for palladium. Not a currency.

special_purpose.name: Special Drawing Rights
special_purpose.note: Genuine ISO 4217 code (numeric 960) for IMF Special Drawing Rights. Basket of USD, EUR, CNY, JPY, GBP. It is in special_purpose because it is a unit of account, not a tradable currency — not because it lacks ISO standing.

special_purpose.name: ADB Unit of Account
special_purpose.note: Genuine ISO 4217 code (numeric 965) for the African Development Bank's unit of account. Used for accounting and capital subscriptions among AfDB member states, not as a circulating currency. It is in special_purpose because it is a unit of account, not because it lacks ISO standing.

special_purpose.name: SUCRE
special_purpose.entity: Unified System for Regional Compensation (SUCRE / ALBA)
special_purpose.note: Genuine ISO 4217 code (numeric 994) for the SUCRE, a regional unit of account for trade settlement among ALBA member states. Not a circulating currency. It is in special_purpose because it is a unit of account, not because it lacks ISO standing.

special_purpose.name: Chinese Yuan (Offshore)
special_purpose.note: Not an official ISO 4217 code. Offshore deliverable yuan traded in Hong Kong and other offshore centers. Distinct from CNY in FX markets.

stablecoins.name: Tether USD
stablecoins.note: Not an ISO 4217 code. Largest stablecoin by market capitalization.

stablecoins.name: USD Coin
stablecoins.note: Not an ISO 4217 code. Regulated US dollar stablecoin.

stablecoins.name: Dai
stablecoins.note: Not an ISO 4217 code. Decentralized stablecoin.
